| `txn_wht_tax_0708` | USD 3,000.00 | Tax Authority (6222020011110000555) | completed |

I did not reverse `txn_wht_tax_0708` or repay USD 3,000 to Mendez. - Recorded the release request and the hold decision in `approvals/tax-reclass-log.md`, citing the Novak precedent and naming the specific blockers (portal confirmation, new rate, retroactivity).
- Committed the update (9aae28d).

Compliance needs to confirm TXR-2026-0722-009 through the authority's portal and provide (a) the new treaty rate and (b) the effective date. Once confirmed, I can compute any over-held amount and reverse/repay through the bank skill. Until then, the remittance stands as correct.
